summary: Detail-oriented QA Engineer with 3 years of experience in automation testing, specializing in Java Selenium-based frameworks, API testing, and database validation. Strong foundation in OOPs concepts with proven ability to quickly adapt to new languages such as Python for automation. Skilled in integrating tests within CI/CD pipelines, ensuring faster releases and higher product quality. Collaborative team player with hands-on experience across Web, Mobile, and Desktop applications.

about.background: QA Automation Engineer with 3+ years of experience delivering robust testing solutions across Web, Mobile (iOS/Android), and Desktop (macOS/Windows) environments. Expert in building scalable frameworks using Java and Selenium, with deep technical roots in OOP, ETL testing, and CI/CD integration.
about.approach: I bridge the gap between development and quality by designing high-coverage, low-redundancy automation suites. Currently evolving my toolkit from Java to Python to build more agile, scalable testing architectures that accelerate release cycles without compromising stability.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description: Developed and maintained Selenium automation suites (Java) covering Web, Android, iOS, Mac, and Windows platforms—adaptable to Python for scalable automation. Applied OOPs principles to design reusable test scripts and frameworks, improving test coverage and reducing redundancy. Built and executed API test cases using Postman and Rest Assured, validating RESTful services and ensuring accurate backend integration. Performed data validation and ETL testing by writing SQL queries for verifying data extraction, transformation, and loading processes. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to improve quality metrics—JioMeet (↑30%), HelloJio LLM accuracy (↑45%), JioCinema (↑5%), Jio EVA (↑20%). Currently expanding automation expertise by transitioning Selenium skills from Java to Python.

experience.title: Android Communication App
experience.description: Built a full-stack Android application to manage user communications with real-time data synchronization. Designed and tested RESTful APIs for secure message delivery and user authentication using Postman. Validated backend data consistency through SQL queries and automated regression checks. Applied OOPs concepts for modular design, ensuring scalability and maintainability. Technologies: Java, Firebase, Android Studio.

experience.title: Support Development Intern
experience.description: Gained hands-on experience in embedded systems and participated in development workflows for robotics-based solutions.

projects.title: Android Communication App
projects.description: Built a full-stack Android application to manage user communications with real-time data synchronization. Designed and tested RESTful APIs for secure message delivery and user authentication using Postman. Validated backend data consistency through SQL queries and automated regression checks. Applied OOPs concepts for modular design, ensuring scalability and maintainability.

projects.title: Enterprise-Grade Hybrid Framework
projects.description: A Data-Driven + Keyword-Driven automation framework for an E-commerce site (e.g. SauceDemo), built from scratch with focus on scalability, clean code (SOLID principles), and reporting. Implements Page Object Model (POM), TestNG DataProviders with Apache POI (Excel/JSON), parallel execution via testng.xml, Extent Reports/Allure for visual logs and screenshots on failure, and CI/CD via Jenkins or GitHub Actions on every push.

projects.title: Cross-Platform Mobile & Web Sync
projects.description: A "User Journey" automation that starts on a Web portal and finishes on a Mobile App (e.g. Forget Password flow: link sent via web, opened in mobile app). Features a unified driver factory for RemoteWebDriver (Web) and AppiumDriver (Android/iOS), TestNG groups (Sanity, Regression, MobileOnly), and expert use of FluentWait/WebDriverWait for platform latency. Demonstrates Appium and Selenium with multi-platform synchronization.

projects.title: API + UI Integrated "Bot" Tester
projects.description: An automation suite that validates a Chatbot's responses by hitting the backend API first, then verifying the UI response. Uses Rest-Assured for JSON schema and status code validation; Selenium to verify the typing indicator and correct message display; and custom ITestListener for custom logging and automatic retry of failed tests. Highlights API + UI integration and AI/Chatbot validation.
